title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...

title: Talk 1
original: O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…

title: Talk 2
original: Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...

title: Talk 3
original: Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…

title: Idle
original: Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...

title: Onboard
original: I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Power... is flowing into me...

title: Promotion 1
original: I have no right to go against your will...

title: Promotion 2
original: Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?

title: Added to Squad
original: Good night, my brothers and sisters.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: As you wish.

title: Depart
original: This will be a path paved with sacrifice.

title: Begin Operation
original: All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Humbly awaiting your command.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Please let me know the results.

title: Deployment 1
original: I come from the depth of the ocean…

title: Deployment 2
original: You are the one who woke me.

title: In Battle 1
original: Grant joy unto me!

title: In Battle 2
original: Return to the abyss!

title: In Battle 3
original: I care not for valueless ones.

title: In Battle 4
original: There's no escape.

title: 4-star Result
original: I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?

title: 3-star Result
original: Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: None of you shall leave this place!

title: Operation Failure
original: They shall pay for this... They must pay…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?

title: Tap
original: Heheh...

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Another year has passed? Ahh, how long my years were spent in the sea, so long I cannot even remember how I last spent them... Never we mind. Tell me, Doctor, would you like to be with me by the windowsill today, to watch the stars?

title: Greeting
original: You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

title: Birthday
original: How did I spend birthdays before now? Heheh. I don't remember too clearly... While I'm still lucid, Doctor, take this. An illuminous pearl, to be a valuable speck of light to you in the dark of night, there among illusory visions…

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Heheheh. I may have seen some vision or other... You should be careful, Doctor. On the route you've chosen, disaster is unavoidable, and it is far more, and far closer, than you ever bargained for. And I—will live in the true field of battle…
